common_voltage_conditions: A single pair V_clear,V_dark must reach the computed charge region at both temperatures.
Measured electrode equilibrium potentials U_W(q,T),U_N(q,T), charge-transfer losses and reversible Li inventory are absent.
For a charge-limited voltage pulse, dQ_Li/dt=I_terminal-I_leak-I_side. Integrated terminal current alone is insufficient when side reactions are unknown.
Changing pulse duration with temperature does not establish a common equilibrium pair, but is allowed as an explicitly defined protocol if the safe-voltage windows overlap.
Open-circuit charge memory would require both thermal retention and reversible switching data; it is not assumed here.
limits: Linear epsilon and linear n,k versus shared charge are two explicit unmeasured paths, not measured electrochemical constitutive laws.
